root_cause.summary: In PR #5736, promotion_launch_guard holds runtime_state_lock(config) across start_worker_for_request. When recovering a worker, mark_worker_recovery_materialized synchronously invoked sync_status_pipeline(config), spawning ai_status.py recover. The child process attempted to acquire runtime_state_lock(config, shared=True), causing an inter-process lock deadlock between parent and child that hung CI until cancelled at the 6-hour timeout.
stack: subprocess.run (ai_status.py recover -> runtime_state_lock contends with parent)

resolution.summary: Decouple synchronous status pipeline sync from the locked worker launch phase and mark_worker_recovery_materialized.

changes.detail: Add sync_projection: bool = True parameter to mark_worker_recovery_materialized; pass sync_projection=False in start_worker_for_request. In promotion_launch_guard, execute sync_status_pipeline(config) strictly outside the runtime_state_lock block.

Add test_mark_worker_recovery_materialized_sync_projection_flag and test_promotion_launch_guard_defers_recovery_projection_outside_runtime_lock to verify the sync_projection flag and lock release timing.

Sanitize runner coordination variables (ORCH_RUNNER_STATUS_PATH, ORCH_HEARTBEAT_PATH, etc.) in test environments so child CLI processes validate PANTHEON_STATUS_ROOT cleanly when executed under worker runtimes.

followup_instructions.action: Once PR #5764 merges into dev, the assignee of OPS-SUPERVISOR-PROMOTION-DRAIN-FENCE-001 (Claude) should merge origin/dev into task/OPS-SUPERVISOR-PROMOTION-DRAIN-FENCE-001. With the supervisor launch/recovery deadlock eliminated on dev, PR #5736 will pass CI and can proceed to independent review and merge.
